about: Odds tables for the consequence engine (companion/consequences.py). Each choice lists its options in the order the code knows them. An option starts at its weight; every rule whose reader matches multiplies the weight by `times` and adds its `why` to the reasons shown in "Why it went this way". Readers: drama (0 quiet to 3 soap opera), closeness_a / closeness_b (how close the companion is to the first / second person in the story, 1 to 5), tie (how the two people know each other: old friends, friends, coworkers, family, married), age_a (the first person's age), sheet (words in the companion's own description; the word groups are in the code), minds (for the user:* choices: 0 to 3, the intensity of an emotional trait the user built into the character that speaks to it; names {trait}), level, cause, closeness and stacked (for user:rough_patch: the Rough patches slider 0 to 3, what happened, how close the companion feels to the user 1 to 5, and how many rough patches over the same thing are already open or started that day), mood and money (the sum of the marks earlier outcomes left on the companion, negative for low or tight). An option's `marks` are what it leaves when picked: kind mood or money with an amount, or avoid (keep away from `about`), on me, a or b, for `days`; `ripple` also reaches the companions who feel close to them; `told` is how the companion carries it, told to them as "you" in the chat context. The user:* and chapter:* choices name each option's `label`; can_<kind> (1 or 0) says whether that life chapter is possible at all, and friends counts the friends in their circle. Names in `why`: {name} the companion, {a} and {b} the people in the story. The love:* choices (companion/life/love_life.py) read love_life (the Their love life slider, 0 to 3), step (how far along the pair is, 0 dating to 7 married), can_up and card (the Life deck's caught-their-eye card in the last month); {partner} names the one they are seeing. The people:* choices (companion/life/their_people.py) read kind (parent, sibling or friend: who the person meeting you is to the companion), romance (1 when you and the companion are a couple), closeness (how close you and the companion are, 1 to 5), pace and social; names {name} the person meeting you (the companion, for a night out) and {b} the companion. The breakup choices (user:strained, user:thinking, user:break, user:falling_out, user:after_break, user:talk_round, user:back_together, user:reach_out; companion/life/breakups.py) read drama, level (the Rough patches slider), closeness, step (how far along the pair is, 0 dating to 7 married), patches (big rough patches of the user's making in the last 45 days, weighed: one over the same thing as another still open counts half, the next a quarter), stacked (how many of those counted for less), cause (the open rough patch's cause), talked (times the user reached out during a break), ended_by (them, you or break), days_apart and months since it ended. The wedding:* choice (companion/life/wedding.py) reads tier (the companion's pay tier, 0 to 3), social (how outgoing they are, 0 to 2), people (how many people are in their circle), drama and pace.
